content: Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Elisee u turo sokɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔn bwɑ̃ɑbun wuurun di u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ sɔɔru koowo kpɑ ɑ ɡum kɔbɑ ye suɑ ɑ kɑ dɑ Rɑmɔtiɔ Gɑlɑdin temɔ.
À n turɑ mi, ɑ doo ɑ Yehu wɑ Yosɑfɑtin bii, Nimusin debubu. A nùn wunɔ wiɡibun suunu sɔɔn di ɑ kɑ dɑ diru ɡɑrun mi, bee tiɑ.
Miyɑ kɑɑ nùn ɡum tɑ̃re u ko sunɔ kpɑ ɑ nùn sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, u koo nùn ko Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko. Yen biru kpɑ ɑ ɡɑmbo kɛniɑ ɑ dukɑ doonɑ. A ku rɑ yɔ̃re.
Mɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ ɑluwɑɑsi wi, u dɑ Rɑmɔti mi, Gɑlɑdin temɔ.

Ye u turɑ mi, yerɑ u deemɑ wee, be, tɑbu sinɑmbu bɑ mɛnnɛ bɑ wesiɑnɑmɔ. Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i mɑn isɑ kuo, nɑ kĩ n kɑ bɛɛn turo ɡɑri ko. Mɑ Yehu u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, bɛsɛn wɑrɑ. Mɑ sɔmɔ wi, u nɛɛ, tɑbu sunɔ wunɑ.
Yerɑ u seewɑ bɑ dɑ yɛnuɔ. Ye bɑ turɑ dirɔ, mɑ u nùn ɡum mɛ tɑ̃re wirɔ u nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, wunɑ u ɡɔsɑ ɑ kɑ ko win tɔmbu Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko.
Kpɑ ɑ wunɛn Yinni Akɑbun bweseru kpuro ɡo. U koo mɑɑ de ɑ win sɔmɔbu kɑ win sɔm kowobu kpuron yɛm mɔɔru mwɑ Yesɑbɛlin mi.
Akɑbun bweseru kpurowɑ u koo de ɑ kpeerɑsiɑ sere kɑ ben bibɔ.
Kpɑ bwese te, tu ko nɡe mɛ Yeroboɑmu Nɛbɑtin biiɡirɑ kuɑ kɑ Bɑsɑ Akiyɑn biiɡiru.
Mɛyɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ Yesɑbɛli sikumɔ, bɔ̃nɑ nu koo win ɡoru tem Yisirɛɛliɔ. Ye Gusunɔn sɔmɔ wi, u ɡɑri yi ɡeruɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ u ɡɑmbo kɛniɑ u dukɑ yɑkurɑ.
Yehu u yɑrimɑ u dɑ u win berusebu deemɑ. Mɑ bɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, n kɑ sere do? Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ wiiro wini u nɑ wunɛn mi. Mɑ Yehu u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛn tii i durɔ wi yɛ̃, i mɑɑ yɛ̃ ye u koo kpĩ u ɡere.
Adɑmɑ bɑ nɛɛ, ɑɑwo, sɑ ǹ yɛ̃. A sun sɔ̃ɔwɔ ye u ɡeruɑ. Mɑ Yehu u nɛɛ, ɑmɛni kɑ ɑmɛniwɑ u mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Yen biru u mɑn ɡum tɑ̃re mɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u mɑn ɡɔsɑ n kɑ ko Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko.
Mii mii bɑ seewɑ bɑ ben yɑ̃nu potirɑ bɑ tɛriɑ dii kɔnnɔn yɔɔtiɑ wɔllɔ bɑ Yehu swĩi mi. Mɑ bɑ kɔbɑ soomɔ bɑ mɔ̀ Yehu u kuɑ sunɔ.
Bɑ nɔɔsinɑ bu kɑ Yorɑmu
Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko ɡo
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Yorɑmu kɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ Sirin sinɑ boko Hɑsɑɛli wɔrim dɑ Rɑmɔtiɔ Gɑlɑdin temɔ. Yerɑ Yehu Yosɑfɑtin bii Nimusin debubu u nùn seesi.

N deemɑ Yorɑmu wi, u ɡinɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yisirɛɛliɔ bɑ nùn nɔɔrimɔ mɛɛrɑ ye u wɑn sɔ̃ sɑnɑm mɛ u tɑbu mɔ̀ kɑ Sirin sunɔ wi. Yerɑ Yehu u win tɑbu sinɑ kpɑɑsibu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ǹ n bɛɛn kĩrun nɑ, i ku de bɑɑ bɛɛn tɔn turo u yɑri u dɑ Yisirɛɛliɔ u sinɑ boko yen lɑbɑɑri sɔ̃.
Sɑɑ yerɑ Yudɑn sinɑ boko Akɑsiɑ u mɑɑ Yorɑmu mɛɛrim nɑ win mɛɛrɑ yen sɔ̃. Yerɑ Yehu u win tɑbu kɛkɛ ye dumi ɡɑwe yɔɔwɑ u mɑɑ dɑ mi.

Mɑ wuu kɔ̃so u Yehun tɑbu wuuru wɑ tɑ wee. Yerɑ u dɑ u sinɑ boko sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ tɑbu wuuru ɡɑru wɑɑmɔ tɑ wee. Mɑ Yorɑmu u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑɑsɔ ɡoo ɡɔrio u dɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, bɔri yɛndun ɡɑriyɑ bɑ kɑ sĩimɔ?

Mɑ mɑɑsɔ wi, u dɑ Yehun mi, u nɛɛ, sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, bɔri yɛndun ɡɑriyɑ i kɑ sĩimɔ? Mɑ Yehu u nɛɛ, mbɑ n nun wɑ, ɑ wuro nɛn biruɔ! Yerɑ kɔ̃so wi, u mɑɑ dɑ sinɑ bokon mi, u nɛɛ, ɡɔro wi, u turɑ tɔn ben mi, ɑdɑmɑ u ǹ ɡɔsirɑmɛ.
Mɑ Yorɑmu u mɑɑ derɑ mɑɑsɔ kpɑo u dɑ. Ye u turɑ mi, yerɑ u nɛɛ, sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, bɔri yɛndun ɡɑriyɑ i kɑ sĩimɔ? Mɑ Yehu u nɛɛ, mbɑ n nun wɑ. A wuro nɛn biruɔ!
Yerɑ kɔ̃so wi, u mɑɑ dɑ sinɑ bokon mi, u nɛɛ, winin tii u turɑ mi. Adɑmɑ u ǹ wurɑmɛ. Tɔn wuu te tɑ mɑɑ wee mi, tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe Yehu Nimusin biiɡiru. Domi wi u tɑbu kɛkɛ ye kpɑre u mɔ̀wɑ nɡe wiiro.

Yerɑ Yorɑmu u nɛɛ, i nɛn tɑbu kɛkɛ sɔɔru koowo, mɑ bɑ ye sɔɔru kuɑ. Yerɑ wi, Yorɑmu, Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko kɑ Akɑsiɑ Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko bɑ seewɑ bɑ dɔɔ bu kɑ Yehu yinnɑ, ben bɑɑwure u wɑ̃ɑ win tɑbu kɛkɛ sɔɔ. Mɑ bɑ Yehu deemɑ Nɑbɔti Yisirɛɛliɡiin ɡbɑɑrɔ.
Yorɑmun ɡɔɔ
Sɑɑ yè sɔɔ Yorɑmu u Yehu wɑ, yerɑ u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ɑlɑfiɑwɑ ɑ kɑ sĩimɔ mɛ? Mɑ Yehu u nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ ɑlɑfiɑ yɑ ko n kɑ wɑ̃ɑ, domi ɑ derɑ wunɛn mɛro Yesɑbɛli u bũnu ɡɑsirimɔ u sɑ̃ɑmɔ mɑ u sɔroru mɔ̀.
Mɑ Yorɑmu u biruku yirɑ wurɑ u dukɑ yɑkurɑ. U nɔɔɡiru suɑ u nɛɛ, kɛ̃sirɑ tunumɑ, Akɑsiɑ.
Sɑɑ yerɑ Yehu u win tɛndu suɑ u Yorɑmu tobɑ win senun bɑɑ sɔɔ. Mɑ sɛ̃u ɡɑ dɑ ɡɑ wɔri win woo sɔndɔ. Mɑ u wɔrumɑ u ɡu, win tɑbu kɛkɛ ye sɔɔ.

Mɑ Yehu u win tɑbu sunɔ turo Bidikɑɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sɑnɑm mɛ sɑ Akɑbu swĩi kɑ dumi ɑ yɑɑye ye Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ win sɔ̃? U nɛɛ, nɡe mɛ Akɑbu u Nɑbɔti kɑ win bibun yɛm yɑri ɡbɑɑ te sɔɔ, nɡe mɛyɑ u koo mɑɑ de win bweserun yɛm mu yɑri ɡbɑɑ te sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ Yorɑmun ɡoo te suo ɑ kɑre ɡbɑɑ ten mi.
Bɑ Akɑsiɑ
Yudɑbɑn sinɑ boko ɡo
Ye Akɑsiɑ u wɑ mɛ, yerɑ u dukɑ suɑ u dɑ Bɛti Gɑni ɡiɑ. Mɑ Yehu u nùn nɑɑ swĩi sere Gurin ɡunɡurɔ, Yibileɑmun bɔkuɔ. Mɑ u nɛɛ, i nùn tweeyo, mɑ bɑ nùn twee bɑ kɑ dɑ Mɛɡidoɔ. Miyɑ u ɡu.
Mɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ win ɡoru suɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ bɑ sikuɑ, win bɑɑbɑbɑn sikɑɔ, Dɑfidin wuuɔ.
N deemɑ Akɑsiɑ wi, u bɑndu diwɑ Yudɑɔ Akɑbun bii Yorɑmun bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ tiɑse sɔɔ.
Bɑ Yesɑbɛli ɡo
Yen biruwɑ Yehu u duɑ Yisirɛɛliɔ. Ye Yesɑbɛli u nuɑ mɛ, yerɑ u win wuswɑɑ burɑru kuɑ u kirobɑ doke nɔniɔ. Mɑ u win wiru yɑrɑ fɛnɛntin di u kɑ yɑm mɛɛrɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yehu u duɑ wuuɔ, yerɑ Yesɑbɛli u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Simiri wi u rɑ win yinni ɡon kɔsire, n sere do ɑ kɑ nɑ mi?
Mɑ Yehu u wuswɑɑ seeyɑ fɛnɛnti yen berɑ ɡiɑ wɔllɔ u nɛɛ, wɑrɑ u kɑ mɑn yɔ̃rɑ. Mɑ sinɑ bokon sɔm kowobun wiruɡibu ɡɑbu yiru ǹ kun mɛ itɑ bɑ nùn mɛɛrimɑ temɔ.
Yerɑ u nɛɛ, i Yesɑbɛli kɑsɑ koomɑ temɔ. Mɑ bɑ nùn kɑsɑ kuɑ. Yerɑ win yɛm yɑri ɡbɑ̃rɑru wɔllɔ, kɑ mɑɑ dumin wɔllɔ. Mɑ Yehu u nùn yɑsisi kɑ tɑbu kɛkɛ ye dumi ɡɑwe.
Yen biruwɑ Yehu u duɑ sinɑ kpɑɑru mi, mɑ u di u nɔrɑ. Yerɑ u nɛɛ, i doo i kurɔ kɑm wi sike domi u sɑ̃ɑwɑ sinɑ bokon bii.
Ye bɑ dɑ, yerɑ bɑ deemɑ win wii koko kɑ win nɑɑsu kɑ nɔm tɑrɑnu tɔnɑwɑ nu wɑ̃ɑ mi, mɑ bɑ nu suɑ bɑ sikuɑ.
Mɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ ye Yehu sɔ̃ɔwɑ, yerɑ u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, mɛyɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ sɑɑ win sɔmɔ Eli Tisibiɡiin nɔɔn di, ye u nɛɛ, bɔ̃nɑ nu koo Yesɑbɛlin ɡoru tem Yisirɛɛlin ɡberɔ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ win wɑsin sukum mu kuɑ tɑɑki Yisirɛɛlin ɡberɔ. Kpɑ bu ku rɑɑ kɑ nɛɛ, Yesɑbɛlin sikirɑ mini.
Bɑ Akɑbun bweseru ɡo
